name: P-2B Assault Droid
description: The P-2B Assault Droid was a model of three-legged battle droid available during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. The P-2B was designed solely to dominate the battlefield, and could be upgraded to use plasma cell ammo. The Twi'lek arms dealer Olok the Shadow sold P-2B Assault Droids in his auction on Darvannis.
